Description:
Ballistics of 115x728R 3UBK7 with the 3BK15 "Zmeya" HEAT-FS projectile, fired from the U-5TS tank gun (GRAU index 2A20). Introduced alongside "Ikra" (100mm D-10T), "Kadet" (100mm T-12), "Nadezha" (125mm), and adopted betweten 1975 and 1978. Projectile includes spiked nosecone.

Round   Proj.   Liner
3UBK7   3BK15   Steel
3UBK7M  3BK15M  Copper

Projectile inset approximately 1.3 dm into cartridge. Per АРТИЛЛЕРИЙСКИЕ МЕТАТЕЛЬНЫЕ ЗАРЯДЫ, the following variation of performance with temperature is known:

T  V     P.mcp
°C m/s   MPa
-40 1014 216.31
15  1060 259.96
40  1089 294.30

Pressure converted from copper crusher gauge to piezoelectric value (0.098 x 1.12) in MPa.
